description: This source file defines a FastAPI web server implementing a backend API for a PDF logo replacement service. It includes endpoints for health checks, starting logo replacement jobs, querying job status, previewing page results, confirming jobs, and downloading the final PDFs. The file configures middleware, initializes storage, and manages routing for all related API functionalities.

methods.name: health_check()
methods.description: API endpoint for health status check.

methods.name: start_logo_replace_job( pdf: UploadFile = File(..., description="The input PDF file"), old_logos: list[UploadFile] = File(..., description="One or more images of the old logo to detect"), new_logo: UploadFile = File(..., description="The new logo image to overlay in place of detected old logos"), dpi: int = Form(250, description="Rasterization DPI for detection (200-300 recommended)"), max_pages: Optional[int] = Form(None, description="Optional cap on number of pages to process"), match_threshold: float = Form(0.8, description="Template matching threshold (0.0-1.0)"), )
methods.description: Endpoint to initiate a new logo replacement job with uploaded files and parameters.

methods.name: get_status(job_id: str)
methods.description: Fetches the current status of a specified job.

methods.name: get_preview(job_id: string, page_index: int, type: str = "detected")
methods.description: Retrieves a PNG preview of a specified page showing detection boxes or overlays.

methods.name: confirm_job(job_id: str)
methods.description: Marks a job as confirmed (stub functionality).

methods.name: download_replaced_pdf(job_id: str)
methods.description: Downloads the final PDF after logo replacement is completed.
